settings.title: More than twenty sections in one app

settings.editor: A lasting charity with no ads and no account, calm design and clear Arabic. Here is a quick tour of its sections.
The next prayer, today's deeds, the hadith of the day, and every section.
The 604-page Madinah Mushaf with many reciters and auto-scroll reading.
Step-by-step recitation lessons, with the rules coloured in the Mushaf.
Times for your city with adhan and iqama, even when the app is closed.
A compass pointing to the Kaaba from where you are, with the distance to Makkah.
Live Quran radio from Cairo and Riyadh, and many reciters.
One dhikr at a time with a counter and its virtue, marked when done.
All daily and occasion adhkar in 133 chapters, with search.
A tasbih counter with chosen adhkar that keeps your daily total.
The Forty Nawawi and Hadith Qudsi, with explanation and word meanings.
Prophets, Companions, the Prophet's family and battles, in short episodes.
A hundred books on worship, dealings, family and manners, with evidence.
Over two thousand questions, with scholars' video answers.
Money, gold, silver, trade, fitr, crops, livestock and treasure, in SAR, EGP and USD.
A daily list of prayers, adhkar and reading, ticked automatically, with a history.
Today in both calendars, the white days, and Islamic and world occasions.
Suhoor and iftar times for every day of Ramadan in your city.
Over 750 questions on Quran, prophets, seerah and fiqh. Challenge your family.
Order the verse, a memory game, and one-minute Quran stories.
The prophets' dialogues with their people as told in the Quran, and famous debates.
Dr Mostafa Mahmoud's episodes on the wonders of creation.

settings.title: Your data stays on your phone

settings.editor: No account, no ads. Your deeds record, zakat numbers and settings stay on your phone; we never receive them.
For a suggestion, a note on one of our apps, or a correction, write to us. We are happy to reply.
